messages:
Ava (Product): Quick sync — we need to lock launch criteria for the console telemetry slice (dashboards, tracing hooks, cost breakdown, error analytics). Customer asks are stacking and we need a firm tradeoff for the next release.

Sam (Eng): quick q — what's the minimal deliverable that will actually unblock sales?

Ava (Product): MVP idea: 3 dashboard widgets (latency P50/P95 histogram, cost per-route summary, error heatmap), a trace-link from request -> trace, coarse per-route token cost estimate, and basic error grouping by exception + prompt-set. No sampling UI or per-token billing drilldown in MVP.

Diego (Eng-ML): for per-route cost estimate we need token attribution + model-variant mapping. Do we have an accuracy target?

Ava (Product): aim for <=5% variance vs billing on top 20 routes during canary; if we can't hit that, we'll label it "estimate" and call out delta in the UI.

Rachel (Sales): Customer Delta & Bankwant both said per-route cost visibility is a gating requirement. They'll stall procurement without it. We need something ship-ready to show them.

Sam (Eng): rough effort: I estimate core widgets 3-4 sprints, tracing-link + SDK change 1 sprint, cost attribution accuracy plumbing another 2 sprints, error grouping 1 sprint. That feels heavy — any way to cut scope and still demo value?

Ava (Product): cut candidates: (1) ship coarse/bucketed per-route cost initially, (2) postpone sampling UI and advanced trace sampling controls to post-launch, (3) error heatmap can be simplified to top-5 errors only.

Diego (Eng-ML): alternative approach: ship coarse per-route cost (buckets: low/med/high) + a "drilldown request export" for customers who want exact numbers immediately. Refine to precise attribution in v1.1.

Sam (Eng): agree. For tracing hooks we only need a tiny SDK patch to attach request_id -> trace_id metadata. That patch can land in 1 sprint if SDK team prioritizes. Example validation query I used for tokens:
```
SELECT route, SUM(tokens) as tokens
FROM requests
WHERE ts > now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
This gives us the top routes to target for per-route accuracy checks.

Ava (Product): Canary acceptance proposal (pilot customers: Delta, Bankwant, and one partner):
- dashboards live and rendering for the three pilots
- per-route cost estimate within 5% for top 20 routes during canary window
- trace-link visible and resolving to a trace for >=95% of pilot requests
- error grouping reduces mean triage time by 20% (measured via solutions team runbook)

Rachel (Sales): I'll line up the pilots and get signed test-data access + SLA on the canary window. We need to make the pilot non-disruptive to customers.

Sam (Eng): rollout plan: feature-flag everything (dashboard widgets, cost estimates, trace-link). Canary in dedicated pools first, then expand to hosted tenants. Need an ops runbook for rollout + rollback.

console-bot: deploy scheduled: canary/telemetry-v1 -> 1708126000 initiated by @Sam :rocket:

Ava (Product): final questions — who owns acceptance tests and docs? Also any UX constraints for the cost widget (currency, model vs route breakdown)?

Sam (Eng): eng owns SDK change + backend telemetry plumbing. Diego will own error grouping logic and metrics. UX: show currency, show model-variant on hover (not in MVP table). Feature flags per-tenant so we can toggle.

Diego (Eng-ML): for error grouping we'll start with stack-trace fingerprinting + prompt-set tag. That should give good signal without heavy infra.

Ava (Product): I'll update the roadmap ticket with the acceptance checklist and capture the cut decisions (bucketed costs initial, sampling UI delayed). I'll also add a short playbook for pilot verification. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Sam (Eng): cool — once the SDK PR is up ping #eng-sdk and I'll review.

Rachel (Sales): I'll share pilot contacts and set dates.

Ava (Product): assigning owners in the ticket now. Follow-ups: Diego to prototype grouping, Sam to open SDK PR, Rachel to confirm pilots.
